description: The three-tier system (observations → reinforced patterns → lessons) has no automated bridging. Lessons are created only when an agent explicitly calls zug_create_lesson, which requires deliberate AI action not guaranteed by any rule or system prompt. At session end (or during synthesis), detect patterns that have been reinforced 3+ times across sessions and surface them as lesson candidates in the zug_end_session response. The agent can then decide whether to promote them. This closes the feedback loop without requiring the agent to remember to check reinforcements manually.
title: Automated observation→lesson pipeline — surface promotion suggestions at session end
